snippet.title: Cassette Beasts 2002 Official Trailer | #TheIndiePremier
snippet.description:
Record, collect, and fuse over 240 creatures as you explore an expansive world filled with mysteries. Uncover the plans of a mysterious occultist in this creature-collecting RPG adventure.

Developed by Bytten Studio and published by Raw Fury.
